scope: Local Linux editor Build and Run workbench; Godot remains a separate backend process.

runtime.graphics: OpenGL 4.6 / Mesa 26.0.8 / AMD Radeon 680M, real window preview

application.skipReason: Archive/mobile helper paths were not supplied to this application run; the desktop Rust suite is reported separately.

desktopRust.ignoreReason: Full production-workspace migration requires explicitly selected author data.

verifiedBehaviors: The GUI checks the saved scene snapshot and submits its digest; changed authoring inputs reject a stale plan before engine execution.
Plan -> real Godot build -> headless ready/moving/idle/finished; separate graphical preview reaches ready and cancels.
Close/reopen observes the same server-owned job. Unsaved drafts block new jobs and returning preserves source text and caret.
Diagnostics map to trusted source paths and JSON pointers; Chinese/English/Japanese labels and 390px layout were exercised.
HTTP enforces loopback socket, exact Host/Origin, existing write authentication, JSON and strict input keys; no caller-selected executable or output path.
SIGTERM and desktop owner EOF stop/reap real Godot, remove the runtime project and preserve authoring file hashes.
UTF-8 output is decoded incrementally; bounded protocol frames validate object identities, payloads and lifecycle order.
limits: Linux local source editor only; packaged Tauri UI and Android device interaction were not exercised.
Artifact is a generated Godot project that requires the recorded engine; standalone executable export is not implemented.
No native Nuis/ns-nova/yalivia, second backend, embedded viewport, GPU compute, arbitrary state machine or live update.
A graphical ready event and synthetic input checks do not certify physical keyboard input.
Timeouts are per phase. Normal shutdown is covered; SIGKILL/power-loss recovery is not implemented.
Current-service job/build IDs do not survive server restart. Only the newest three builds created by that service are retained; previous sessions and CLI outputs are untouched.
No version bump, release packaging, installation, commit or push.
